new_from_file.brief: Reads the page setup from the file `file_name`.
new_from_file.md:
Reads the page setup from the file `file_name`.

Returns a new `GtkPageSetup` object with the restored
page setup, or `NULL` if an error occurred.
See [`PageSetup.to_file()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PageSetup#method:to_file).

new_from_gvariant.brief: Desrialize a page setup from an a{sv} variant.
new_from_gvariant.md:
Desrialize a page setup from an a{sv} variant.

The variant must be in the format produced by
[`PageSetup.to_gvariant()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.PageSetup#method:to_gvariant).

new_from_key_file.brief: Reads the page setup from the group `group_name` in the key file `key_file`.
new_from_key_file.md:
Reads the page setup from the group `group_name` in the key file
`key_file`.

Returns a new `GtkPageSetup` object with the restored
page setup, or `NULL` if an error occurred.
